_comment: A broad, varied quality set for the live relay (see eval.mjs).
Each item is ONE request, sent the way the plugin sends it: chat lines with
an author and optional context; surface texts (status, bio, embed, poll,
topic, title, event) with no author and no context, plus `kind`.
`reading` is the intended native reading, for the human judge only. It is
never sent. No item is a target: the set exists so a change is judged on
